description: A velvet noise generator: sparse one-sample pulses of alternating sign, with a second jack giving plain white noise

params.text: Sets how often a pulse appears, silence at the counter-clockwise end and a pulse on nearly every sample at the clockwise end; the setting is cubed, so most of the change is at the top
Chooses between pulses of a fixed 10V and pulses whose height falls as the density rises; on the sloped setting the height runs from 33.75V at zero density down to 1.25V at full

inputs.text: Adds to the density knob, where 1V covers the whole of the knob's travel, and the total is clamped at full density above that

outputs.text: The velvet noise: 0V between pulses, and one sample either up or down where a pulse lands, the direction chosen at random

notes: both jacks are made from the same random number on each sample, so a velvet pulse only ever lands where the white noise output is near the bottom of its swing
on the sloped mode the pulses reach 33.75V at low densities, well outside the ±12V that Rack modules normally keep to

inputs.0:
0 to 1V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
